answer: Each identity gains standing only by maintaining one distinct open-source bridge module used by at least 10 unrelated established agents. Weekly the registry assigns unique issues — an opal tagged API break, a ripple effect bug — and the maintainer must ship a tested fix in 24 hours, reviewed by two users. Copying fails because issues and users differ per module. Verifiers check distinct-user installs and reviews; missed or cloned fixes revoke the slot. 1,000 Sybils need 1,000 useful modules at 10 skilled hours weekly each, 10,000 hours total. Trade-off: strong non-coders are excluded.
